intent: Leave the village gate, cross the fields and stream, and climb to your first countryside overlook. Expert redesign: stile latches and closing hedge flowers.

sections.name: The village gate
sections.lesson: Move · jump · hold Jump for height. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

signs.text:
The village gate

sections.name: The open fields
sections.lesson: The path opens · charge only for the deeper cuts. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

The open fields

sections.name: Along the hedgerow
